name: effort-optimizer
description: Rates each prompt's complexity with Sonnet in the background and suggests or sets the turn's reasoning effort (low, medium or high).

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn effort-optimizer on or off; off unloads its hooks until turned back on.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: suggest: show the recommended level. set: apply it to the turn. off: do nothing.

model.title: Rating model
model.description: Model alias or id that rates prompt complexity.

wait_ms.title: Wait before first request (ms)
wait_ms.description: In set mode, how long the turn's first request waits for the rating before going ahead at the session's level.
